verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs say MoQ relays are free to use during the beta, so development and early testing currently cost nothing. That allowance is tied to the beta period, though, and nothing says what free tier or allowance continues afterward. Missing for 10: a documented permanent free tier or usage allowance, post-beta pricing and limits, and independent corroboration of no-cost usage.

support.subject: As a founder, a free tier or free usage allowance covers development and early testing

citations.quote: They are free to use during the beta period.
